28c77530-dfa1-4b05-8ec3-998960ba24d4.title: Otome Game Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu
28c77530-dfa1-4b05-8ec3-998960ba24d4.altTitle: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs
28c77530-dfa1-4b05-8ec3-998960ba24d4.description: Leon, a former Japanese worker, was reincarnated into an "otome game" world, and despaired at how it was a world where females hold dominance over males. It was as if men were just livestock that served as stepping stones for females in this world. The only exceptions were the game's romantic targets, a group of handsome men led by the crown prince. In these bizarre circumstances, Leon held one weapon: his knowledge from his previous world, where his brazen sister had forced him to complete this game.

b29da26e-39f2-4e64-b96f-62818b209d73.description: One day, Kuroda Yusei, an introverted high school student with zero dating experience, returns a lost little girl to her house... when the most beautiful girl in his grade, Shirakawa Ayano, appears! "As thanks for saving my sister," she begins to approach him boldly for some reason, and every day is filled with mishaps!? On top of that, a busty otaku classmate and an attention-seeking junior girl also appear, and his daily life suddenly becomes more glamorous!?

ad5e875e-abaa-4fa3-ab75-b93a172ed35c.description:
A colorful ensemble romantic comedy from the web!

The heroines have a variety of personalities, including a "royal tsundere," "a childhood friend who comes on strong," "a natural classmate," and "a younger sister who's a bit of a jerk." A lovey-dovey ensemble drama with heroines with rich personalities and their respective partners! Please savor the sweet and sour and sad coming-of-age episodes...!

1c0ba6ea-0f98-4da7-9069-0c30be7e7575.title: The Cold-Blooded Warrior
1c0ba6ea-0f98-4da7-9069-0c30be7e7575.description:
Han Jaewoo is a sweat in the world-famous game "Savior Of Humanity."

Once a hardcore player, now drowning in debt in his tiny room.

His long-awaited showdown with a demon lord ends in an unexpected failure.

The debt collectors are closing in... and all that's left to him are despair and stubborn grit.

That's when Aquila, the administrator, appears with an offer:

"Don't you want to see it? The true happy ending of this game..."

With a prize of 25 million dollars on the line, and the path to the true ending finally revealed, he accepts it.

However, there's a catch:

He's thrown back into the game world with all his stats reduced to rock bottom.

"Thanks for the 'realism,' Aquila... Screw it. I'm clearing this damn thing!"

c14c3462-08b6-4ce1-be95-fdfec78bb11b.title: DIE LOVE
c14c3462-08b6-4ce1-be95-fdfec78bb11b.description: Ever since they were young, Cha Inwoo had a quiet crush on his next-door neighbor, Kwak Hajun. But Hajun was completely different from Inwoo. He was popular, outgoing, and part of a completely different world. The only connection between them was being neighbors. That was it. With the college entrance exams approaching, Inwoo believed their already distant connection would naturally fade away once they started their separate lives in college. But on exam day, a piercing scream shattered the stillness of the school hallway…

d6c29c61-f822-4f66-95ea-9531a53b4cc4.title: Let's Change The Ending To Home Education
d6c29c61-f822-4f66-95ea-9531a53b4cc4.description:
“If only I had straightened out that bratty young marquis earlier…!”

Could my luck be any worse?
First, my father’s business went under and my engagement was broken off.
Then I had to become a private tutor just to support my family.
And now… I’m caught up in a rebellion and about to be executed?!

Why should I have to die—because of that spoiled, clueless marquis?
Dragged into treason I didn’t even commit?!
If only I’d had the chance to fix that arrogant brat’s rotten manners and twisted personality back then…
If only I’d had the chance!

When I opened my tightly shut eyes, I found myself back in the past—at age twenty-two.
I sought out the young marquis, who had lost his parents and been placed in the care of a duke, and applied to be his tutor.

Little by little, through effort and patience, the boy began to open his heart to me.
But now… it feels like someone else’s heart is opening too—His Grace, the Duke himself?!
